scientific_intent.application_domain: Paired three-dimensional volume intensity sampling for registration-style comparison
scientific_intent.operator: Transform jittered coordinates and trilinearly interpolate two UInt8 volumes with validity mask
scientific_intent.community_use_case: An intensity-pair sampling stage from which a registration similarity histogram could be formed; no clinical dataset, registration optimization, estimated transform quality, or mutual-information kernel is evaluated.
scientific_intent.governing_method: Eight-corner trilinear interpolation, affine coordinate transformation, nearest-integer intensity quantization
scientific_intent.scientific_scope: Native fractional z-index formula and fixed97 jitter sequence preserved. Source describes rigid transformation but original random matrix is not constrained to rotations; named study only identity/positive translation. Histogram is CPU postprocessing, excluded from timed kernel.
accuracy_needs: Explicit Float32-to-UInt8 quantization near half-bin thresholds

shared_observed_usage_windows.scope: Consumed inference tokens during declared phase, including repeated/cached context and any coordination. Marker-turn alignment is approximate; not exclusive source translation or monetary billing. Cached input and reasoning are subsets, not extra totals. No historical recovery. Parent/shared workflow spans overlap subphases and must not be added to them.
shared_observed_usage_windows.counter_span_interpretation: Observed counter difference; alignment and interleaving prevent exclusive billed-cost claims. Zero/no-new-event spans cannot imply zero translation effort.
